mechanism: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially increasing armodafinil plasma concentrations; armodafinil may increase ciprofloxacin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition, with additive CNS stimulation risk.
action: Monitor for increased armodafinil adverse effects (insomnia, anxiety, tremor) and ciprofloxacin toxicity; consider dose adjustment or alternative antibiotic if excessive CNS stimulation occurs.
